dashboard.peopleHelp: The average service attendance over the last reported 3 months.

dashboard.givingMFPHelp: The average Missions Faith Pledge and missions giving given over the last reported 3 months. This amount should include any giving to missions from the churches general fund, as many churches give a % of their general income to missions.
dashboard.peopleInCGHelp: The average cell group attendance over the last reported 3 months, as a % of the average adult and youth weekly service attendance, over the same period.

overseerMetric.churchesHelp: The total number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation
overseerMetric.peopleHelp: This is the average number of people in that Leaders Region or Nation, calculated over the last reported 3-months, for each church, then totalled.
overseerMetric.churchesReportingHelp: The number of churches that have made monthly reports in the last 3-months, expressed as a % of the total number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation.
overseerMetric.moreChurchesHelp: This is the % growth in the Number of churches in the Leaders Region or Nation, compared to the number of churches in the same period the previous year
overseerMetric.churchesGrowingHelp: The % of churches that are growing in that Leaders Region or Nation. It is calculated as a 3-months average, compared to a 3-month average over the same period the previous year
overseerMetric.nationsHelp: The number of Nations in that Leaders Region
overseerMetric.churchesPlantingHelp: The number of Churches that have pioneered a Church in the last 3-years, compared to the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %, excluding any churches that failed and were removed / disabled.
overseerMetric.churchesWithCgsHelp: The number of Churches that have Connect Groups (Cell Groups), calculated from the last time each church reported, compared against the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %.
overseerMetric.churchesWithGtLiwHelp: The number of Churches that have Growth Track and or Life In the Word classes, calculated from the last time each church reported, compared against the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %.
overseerMetric.churchesWithTithesOfferingsText: Percent of Churches with Tithes & Offerings
overseerMetric.churchesWithTithesOfferingsHelpTitle: % of Churches taking up Tithes & Offerings
overseerMetric.churchesWithTithesOfferingsHelp: The number of Churches giving Tithes & Offerings, calculated from the last time each church reported, compared against the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %.
overseerMetric.churchesWithMfpHelp: The number Churches with Missions Faith Pledges and missions giving from the churches general fund, calculated from the last time each church reported, compared against the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %
overseerMetric.churchesVisitedText: Percent of Churches Visited in 2 Years
overseerMetric.churchesVisitedHelp: The number of Churches visited by a Leader, in the last 2-years, compared to the number of churches in that Leaders Region or Nation, expressed as a %.

support.title: OMR Support
support.intro:
Hi {name},

Welcome to OMR, your monthly reporting tool designed to help you manage your church and church planting.

Help yourself and those you are leading by submitting your monthly reports regularly.

If you have any recommendations, please feel free to contact me.
If you are experiencing any difficulties, I will do my best to assist you.

Just complete the form below.

Blessings,
Shane Comiskey
